name: Chieftain
description: Exerting dominance over their snarling kin through acts of grisly violence, the Chieftain leads ruinous stampedes into civilised lands.

name: Bestigor
description: The brutish Bestigor are the elite warriors of the herd, arming themselves with the best weapons and armour plundered from human lands.

name: Bray-Shaman
description: The Bray-Shamans commune directly with the Dark Gods and speak with their voices, making them the most revered of all Beastmen.

choose.prompt: When recruiting a Bray-Shaman, you must select one of the following magical abilities. In addition, the Bray-Shaman may select another magical ability instead of selecting a heroic talent.

name: Gor
description: Large, powerful and numerous, the Gor form the spine of every warherd. Though their appearance varies greatly, their horns set them above lesser breeds of beastmen.

name: Ungor
description: Ungors are vicious and spiteful creatures. They are the lowest creatures in the hierarchy of the wilds, subject to savage torments by larger beastmen.

name: Chaos Hound
description: Possessing the ferocity and stature of wolves, these mutated hounds race toward their prey in slavering packs, their fanged maws snapping in anticipation of the kill.
